sentences.en: Australians don't need motivation to drink beer, it comes natural.
sentences.zh: 1. 澳大利亚人不需要喝啤酒的动力，这是自然而然的事情。

sentences.en: That teacher destroyed all of my motivation to learn Berber.
sentences.zh: 2. 那位老师摧毁了我学习柏柏尔语的所有动力。

sentences.en: He found the motivation to learn Berber on his own.
sentences.zh: 3. 他找到了自己学习柏柏尔语的动力。

senses.zh: 动机的，动力的 形容词: motivational
